target_transform: log — model is trained on log(effort_hours); prediction is returned as exp(output)

function_points.description: Adjusted Function Points (AFP) — functional size of the software

performance_requirements.description: Demand for performance and speed constraints (Likert 1–5)

installation_ease.description: Ease of deployment and installation (Likert 1–5; higher = easier)

preprocessing_pipeline.step_1: StandardScaler fitted on [performance_requirements, complex_processing, installation_ease, additional_complexity_factor] — artifact: scaler_pca_features.pkl
preprocessing_pipeline.step_2: PCA(n_components=2) — artifact: pca_2.pkl — explains ~70% of variance
preprocessing_pipeline.note: scaler_maxx.pkl is a legacy artifact fitted on 9 ISBSG features; do NOT use it for the 4 Maxwell Likert factors

dataset.name: Maxwell
dataset.source: K.D. Maxwell, Applied Statistics for Software Managers, 2002
